description: Remove (unenroll) one of the user's added cards. Irreversible for that enrollment: any virtual cards created against it are closed first, then the card is unenrolled at the network. ALWAYS confirm with the user before calling. Get ids from list_added_cards. The user can add the same card again later (create_card with restart_setup: true).

attached_card_id.description: The id of the added card to remove (from list_added_cards).

name: remove_added_card

closedCards.description: How many virtual cards created against it were closed.

id.description: The id of the removed card.
